summary: Frontend-only regression testing passed the curriculum, lesson rendering, desktop collapse, mobile drawer, overflow, and test-ID flows. A desktop internal-scroll usability issue remains for the 25-item FreeRTOS list.

issues: At 1920x1080 with Level 5 (25 lessons) expanded, curriculum navigation scrollHeight equals clientHeight (1403px), so the sidebar grows beyond the viewport rather than providing an internal scroll region. Mobile does provide an internal scroll range.

action_items: Constrain the desktop sidebar/nav to the viewport height (for example via a height/min-height chain) so long lesson lists scroll inside curriculum-navigation instead of expanding the page.
critical_code_review_comments: .curriculum-nav has overflow-y:auto and min-height:0, but its flex parent is not explicitly constrained to the viewport; the desktop sidebar therefore expands with long lesson content and the intended scroll container is ineffective.
seed_data_creation: None; curriculum data is local by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified all 9 levels and lesson counts (11, 19, 16, 19, 14, 25, 21, 19, 20), dynamic title/level/description/context, welcome hero removal, second selection, desktop collapse, mobile drawer close-on-selection, unique test IDs, and no horizontal overflow. Recheck desktop internal scrolling after CSS sizing fix.
rca of the issue: The nav overflow rule is present, but the desktop sidebar flex column has no explicit viewport-constrained height. Its content can determine the sidebar height, making nav clientHeight equal scrollHeight for the long Level 5 list. Constrain the sidebar/app height while retaining nav min-height:0 and overflow-y:auto.
